label: RS-yaml-E1-r8
answer:
```
composer.py: Provides the Composer class for building a tree of nodes from parsing events, essential for document composition.
constructor.py: Offers classes for constructing Python objects from a YAML node, handling complex data types during deserialization.
cyaml.py: Implements C-based YAML parser and emitter for performance-critical applications, providing faster processing.
dumper.py: Defines the Dumper class for serializing Python objects into YAML, including support for different output styles.
emitter.py: Manages the emission of YAML parsing events into a YAML stream, controlling the output format and structure.
loader.py: Implements the Loader class for parsing YAML streams into Python objects, serving as a frontend for the constructor.
parser.py: Parses YAML streams into parsing events, translating the input stream into a sequence of events for further processing.
reader.py: Reads a YAML stream and decodes it into Unicode, handling input stream reading and character decoding.
resolver.py: Resolves scalars into appropriate YAML tags, determining the correct data type for scalar values during parsing.
scanner.py: Scans a YAML stream and produces tokens, breaking down the input into meaningful lexical units for parsing.
serializer.py: Serializes a sequence of events into a YAML stream, managing document starts and ends and tag declarations.
representer.py: Provides mechanisms to represent Python objects as YAML nodes, essential for the serialization process.
```
